description: This file declares external API functions for interacting with device parameters and instance numbers within the Cosa framework, primarily related to data model management in the broadband device environment.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueUlong
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value given its name.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value given its name, buffer, and size.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value given its name.

methods.name: CosaGetInstanceNumberByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the instance number associated with an object name and index.
